<DIV><FONT size="1" style="font-size:1pt;color:white">&#8203;To Our Shareholders:&#8203; &#8203;We continue to make progress towards our ambitious target of capturing 10% of the global gaming&#8203; &#8203;content market and an even greater share of the U.S. market. In Q1 2026, revenue grew 39%&#8203; &#8203;year-over-year to $1.4 billion and bookings grew 43% year-over-year to $1.7 billion. It will empower creators to construct interactive&#8203; &#8203;environments where high-fidelity visuals and autonomous motion coexist without compromise.&#8203; &#8203;We operate over 400 AI models running over 1.5 million inferences per second across on-premise&#8203; &#8203;and public cloud GPUs. Substantially all of our bookings are generated from sales of virtual&#8203; &#8203;currency, which can ultimately be converted to virtual items on the Roblox platform. Sales of virtual&#8203; &#8203;currency reflected as bookings include one-time purchases or monthly subscriptions purchased&#8203; &#8203;via payment processors or through prepaid cards. Bookings are initially recorded in deferred&#8203; &#8203;revenue and recognized as revenues over the estimated period of time the virtual items purchased&#8203; &#8203;with the virtual currency are available on the Roblox platform (estimated to be the average lifetime&#8203; &#8203;of a paying user) or as the virtual items purchased with the virtual currency are consumed.&#8203; &#8203;Bookings also include an insignificant amount from advertising and licensing arrangements. We&#8203; &#8203;believe bookings provide a timelier indication of trends in our operating results that are not&#8203; &#8203;necessarily reflected in our revenue as a result of the fact that we recognize the majority of&#8203; &#8203;revenue over the estimated average lifetime of a paying user. The change in deferred revenue&#8203; &#8203;constitutes the vast majority of the reconciling difference from revenue to bookings. By removing&#8203; &#8203;these non-cash adjustments, we are able to measure and monitor our business performance&#8203; &#8203;based on the timing of actual transactions with our users and the cash that is generated from these&#8203; &#8203;transactions. Over the long term, the factors impacting our revenue and bookings trends are the&#8203; &#8203;same. However, in the short term, there are factors that may cause revenue and bookings trends to&#8203; &#8203;differ.&#8203; &#8203;19&#8203; </FONT></DIV>

We believe that, when considered together with reported GAAP amounts, Adjusted&#8203; &#8203;EBITDA is useful to investors and management in understanding our ongoing operations and&#8203; &#8203;ongoing operating trends. Our definition of Adjusted EBITDA may differ from the definition used by&#8203; &#8203;other companies and therefore comparability may be limited.&#8203; &#8203;Free cash flow&#8203;&#8203;represents the net cash and cash equivalents&#8203;&#8203;provided by operating activities, less&#8203; &#8203;purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets acquired through asset acquisitions.&#8203; &#8203;We believe that free cash flow is a useful indicator of our unit economics and liquidity that provides&#8203; &#8203;information to management and investors about the amount of cash and cash equivalents&#8203; &#8203;generated from our core operations that, after the purchases of property and equipment, and&#8203; &#8203;intangible assets acquired through asset acquisitions, can be used for strategic initiatives.&#8203; &#8203;20&#8203; </FONT></DIV>
